versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-migration-mas-product-mapping v0.0.1 – initial release.

- Provides cross-vendor cloud product mapping for AWS, Tencent Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and Azure to Alibaba Cloud.
- Supports name and instance spec mapping, usage conversion, and real-time Alibaba Cloud pricing.
- Accepts input as plain text, JSON, or Excel/CSV cloud bills and auto-detects vendor.
- Enforces confirmation of source vendor and target Alibaba Cloud region before pricing.
- Pricing service uses Alibaba Cloud's default credential chain; hardcoded credentials are forbidden.
- Outputs vendor-to-product mapping in markdown table, includes fallback and normalization for unavailable specs.
